 No Plans for Doha Meeting between Iran's SNSC Chief, US VP: Security Official 
 November, 09, 2026 - 20:01 
 Politics news 
 TEHRAN (Tasnim) – A senior Iranian security official denied any plans for a meeting between Secretary of Iran's National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei and US Vice President JD Vance in Doha, Qatar. 
 Politics 
 The senior security official in Tehran, dimissed reports in certain media outlets regarding a meeting between Rezaei and Vance, saying that Iran’s policy and plans concerning negotiations remain unchanged.
 The official emphasized that unless the American side takes practical action within the framework of the seven conditions stipulated by Iran, there will be no plans for negotiations with the US side.
